Definition and dimension: Scan index; number of eligible scans
How to interpret it: A participant may contribute multiple visits; i is not a participant index.
A matrix entry is connectivity between two ROIs, not a regional volume.
Take each unordered ROI pair once; omit the diagonal.
Rows are scans; columns refer to the same ROI pair across scans.
q(i) defines grouping in cross-validation; visits remain together.
b(i) combines dataset and site; cᵢ encodes covariates to preserve.
